map.查询中医二十八脉的脉象特征与主病对应（基于《濒湖脉学》《中医诊断学》脉诊内容）: Look up the pulse features and disease correspondence of the twenty-eight TCM pulses (based on the pulse diagnosis content of Binhu Maixue and TCM Diagnostics)
map.二十八脉按位、数、形、势四要素辨识：浮脉主表、沉脉主里、迟脉主寒（一息不足四至）: The twenty-eight pulses are identified by four elements - position, rate, form and force: floating indicates exterior, deep indicates interior, slow indicates cold (fewer than four beats per breath), rapid indicates heat (five or more beats per breath), deficient indicates deficiency, forceful indicates excess, slippery indicates phlegm, food stagnation, floating and rapid indicates heat, and choppy indicates qi stagnation and blood stasis. Disease is read from the four dimensions of pulse depth, rate, size and force.

map.⚠️ 脉诊需在安静环境下，平卧或正坐，手臂与心脏平齐。常采用\"寸口诊法\"，分: ⚠️ Pulse diagnosis requires a quiet environment, lying flat or sitting upright, with the arm level with the heart. The "cun-kou" method is commonly used, dividing into cun, guan and chi positions, each taken at floating, middle and deep, giving nine subdivisions. This tool is for TCM study reference.
map.📋 常见脉象鉴别要点: 📋 Key points for differentiating common pulses
map.沉脉（重按始得）: Deep pulse (only felt with heavy pressure)
map.浮主表，沉主里: Floating indicates exterior, deep indicates interior
map.迟脉（一息不足四至）: Slow pulse (fewer than four beats per breath)
map.数脉（一息五至以上）: Rapid pulse (five or more beats per breath)
map.迟主寒，数主热: Slow indicates cold, rapid indicates heat
map.虚主不足，实主有余: Deficient indicates insufficiency, forceful indicates excess
map.滑主痰食实热，涩主血少气滞: Slippery indicates phlegm, food, excess heat; choppy indicates blood deficiency and qi stagnation
map.洪主热盛，细主气血两虚: Flooding indicates flourishing heat, thin indicates deficiency of both qi and blood
map.选「浮」（表）+「数」（热）→浮数主风热表证，苔薄黄、发热；提示辛凉解表。: Selecting "floating" (exterior) + "rapid" (heat) → floating rapid indicates a wind-heat exterior pattern with thin yellow coating and fever; acrid-cool exterior release is indicated.
map.选「弦」→主肝胆病/痛/痰饮，兼滑则肝胆湿热，治宜疏肝利胆。: Selecting "wiry" → indicates liver and gallbladder disease, pain or phlegm-fluid; combined with slippery it becomes liver-gallbladder damp-heat, treated by soothing the liver and promoting bile flow.
map.浮沉迟数滑涩弦洪细虚等，位/数/形/势四维区分。: Floating, deep, slow, rapid, slippery, choppy, wiry, flooding, thin, deficient and the like, distinguished across the four dimensions of position, rate, form and force.
map.单脉能确诊？: Can a single pulse confirm a diagnosis?
map.不能，须与舌症合参，工具仅给主病提示。: No. It must be combined with tongue and symptoms; the tool only offers primary disease hints.
